items.title: AI Sessions
items.note: Dashboard is a Bundle/Session list (model, provider, timestamp, source Bundle, report-exists) per CAP-009/ADR-022 — not a metrics board.

items.title: Bundles
items.note: Retrieved mail, materialized per filter execution (CAP-019). Independently readable and annotatable without invoking Copilot.

items.title: Copilot
items.note: No 'AI' prefix in UI copy. An optional action on a Bundle (summarize/draft/find), never the entry point to one (INTENT-03 item 7).

mobileNavigation.note: Replaces the desktop sidebar on mobile/TWA viewports, per CAP-020/ADR-022. Not a 1:1 mirror of the desktop groups above — it's a 5-slot bottom bar.

centerSlot.title: Copilot
centerSlot.note: Always center. Never reassignable or hideable, unlike every other slot.

candidateDestinations.title: Home
candidateDestinations.behavior: Tapping expands a menu of the full destination set rather than navigating directly.

candidateDestinations.title: Retrieve
candidateDestinations.behavior: Tapping the icon fetches against the active filter; a chip beneath it names that filter and opens the full filter picker on tap.

overflow.behavior: Opens a bottom drawer listing the destinations that don't fit in the 4 visible slots.

mobileNavigation.activeIconNote: The active/selected destination's icon turns amber; its label stays neutral.
